title: Batman: The Long Halloween
desc: A poster art I made of one of my favorite comics, featuring iconic characters such as two-face and Joker

title: Zagreus
desc: This is a drawing of Zagreus, Prince of the Underworld from the critically acclaimed video game "Hades"

title: Batman: Dark Victory
desc: A poster of Batman from Dark Victory, dropping in against a hard orange field. The cape fills most of the frame in black and slate blue, with the yellow eyes and the line "I ALWAYS FIND MY WAY IN THE DARK" as the only extra detail.

title: Sandman X Metallica
desc: This is a piece I made of the comic book character Dream, otherwise know as The Sandman. He is depicted shredding on an electric guitar, giving a nod to Metallica's timeless hit "Enter Sandman."

title: Spiderman
desc: A drawing of Spiderman that utilizes bold colors and shadows, emphasizing the dynamic between him and his spidey senses on the foreground.

title: Dante Sparda
desc: Dante has always been one of my favorite video game characters. This drawing depicts a younger Dante, particularly from Devil May Cry 3: Dante's Awakening. This piece was stylized as a more poster-like aesthetic.

title: Super Buu
desc: Buu is an iconic villain from the acclaimed anime series Dragon Ball Z. This drawing utilizes multiple shades of pink to portray the lighting on Buu's skin, with his magical power orbs in his hands being the main light source of this piece.

title: Deadpool
desc: This drawing of the comic book character Deadpool uses black and whites as well as screentones for shading. This allows for the green portions to really pop and draw the audience's attention to these critical parts, which allows the viewer's eye to follow the piece in a natural, streamlined manner.

title: Wolverine
desc: A drawing of the iconic X-Men character, Wolverine. Apart from black and white, this piece utilizes 4 colors, one of which is the blood on wolverine's claws. Although a more violent piece, it is able to captivate the audience by drawing their eye to the critical portions, his claws, muscles, and eventually his cowl.

title: Godrick the Grafted
desc: This is a digital piece of a popular antagonist from the video game Elden Ring, produced by Fromsoftware.

title: Sekiro - the Great Serpent
desc: Sekiro is another popular video game created by Fromsoftware. The game features a mythical, feudal Japanese setting with monstrous characters and enemies. This piece highlights the great serpent that is present throughout the game in the mountains, with the protagonist, Sekiro, in the foreground

title: Batman Beyond
desc: Batman Beyond from a low angle, cape spread against a yellow Gotham skyline. The red bat on the chest and the white eyes do most of the work.

title: Lothric & Lorian
desc: Lothric and Lorian from Dark Souls III, drawn in black and white with screentone. Lorian sits with the greatsword out while Lothric clings to his back, and their iconic voice line hangs over them.

title: Naruto
desc: Naruto lunging in with a kunai in his teeth. The orange jacket and blue eyes sit on a clean white background so the viewer notices the punch seamlessly first.

title: Chainsaw Man
desc: Denji in his Chainsaw Man form, inverted as white linework on black. The saw-head and the extra blade on the arms are the whole silhouette.

title: Grenadier - Gears of War
desc: A Locust Grenadier from Gears of War, hunched with a Lancer in one hand and a grenade in the other. Black-and-white line with screentone, and the walking motion as the extra bit of story.

title: Goku
desc: Goku charging a Kamehameha, hands huge in the foreground with blue energy spraying off them.

title: D&D Original Character
desc: An original D&D character for my good friend Elijah - a runed orc caster conjuring fire out of both hands. Mostly ink, with orange and yellow only in the flames.

title: Nightwatch #1 Concept Cover
desc: Concept cover for Nightwatch #01. The masked lead sits under the spotlight eye logo, knife in one and and a silenced pistol in the other, framed like a comic-book issue.

title: Nightwatch Concept Conversation
desc: A concept conversation between the hooded watcher and a chrome-helmet type. Tight crop, black speech bubbles, the two of them talking past each other.

title: Nightwatch Action Scene Concept
desc: Action-scene concept of the watcher over a fallen chrome fighter. The dialogue is about crossing into the watcher's territory

title: Nightwatch Biker Concept
desc: Early biker concept, mostly construction lines. The bike is inked; the rider is still in red sketch, seen from a low head-on view.

title: Nightwatch Main Weapon Concept
desc: Line sheets for the main Nightwatch weapon. Top and side views of a heavy pistol, plus a folded-stock version.

title: S3QUENCE Strike Banner
desc: Key art for a S3QUENCE strike: a blue fighter throwing a punch that lines up with a directional arrow. This is the look of the combat.

title: S3QUENCE Start Button
desc: Pixel START word from the title screen.

title: Poison Item
desc: A 16-pixel item tile. The poison item is an upgrade that inflicts a damage over time effect on the enemy. The syringe animation plays when the item is active.

title: Initial Surge Item
desc: A 16-pixel item tile that depicts a wave which is animated when active. The item boosts the character's damage output in the first half of the encounter.

title: Radio - Upgrade Screen
desc: Pixel HUD layout with the player portrait and an unknown character. Players will use this screen to upgrade their equipment and buy upgrades as well as engage in dialogue with other characters. Inspired by the CODEC from the Metal Gear Solid series.

title: Process 1: Original Character
desc: Line study of an original character in a horned mask, drawing dual katanas with heavy black cords looping behind them and into the helmet

title: Process 2: Panelling
desc: A panelling study: a faint full-figure sketch of a spiked reaper on top, and a tight inked skull close-up underneath.

title: Process 3: Falling Woman
desc: Gesture study of a woman falling, hair and sleeves whipping back, one hand reaching toward the viewer.

title: Process 4: Wolverine
desc: Early construction for a Wolverine piece. The claws are the only firm lines; the body is still in light sketch.

title: Process 5: Punching Pose
desc: Rough punching-pose construction. Big simple volumes for the head, torso, and the fist coming forward. This was eventually used for the Naruto piece.

title: Process 6: Goku
desc: Line pass for the Goku Kamehameha piece, locking in the oversized hands before color.

title: Process 7: Necromorph
desc: Line study of a necromorph from the horror game series Dead Space, all hooked limbs and a hollow ribcage, reaching forward.

title: Process 8: Spiderman
desc: Clean lineart pass for the Spiderman portrait, focusing on the webbing and the shape of the eyes.

title: Process 9: Wolverine
desc: In-progress Wolverine from behind. The bloody claws are fully rendered while the cowl and back are still in pencil.

title: Process 10: Dante
desc: Line-and-flat pass for the Dante poster, with the Ebony & Ivory gun in the foreground and the DANTE type locked in behind him.

title: Process 11: Original D&D Character
desc: Studies for an original D&D character: construction of a dragonborn figure and a small painted companion dragon.
